body: The vehicle map has pencil ticks at three stops. Dark grain in its fold looks like that in the half empty bag.
title: Map, seed bag and pencil

body: Soap floats in green wash water. Two different work gloves are jammed into the same bucket. They were put there after a field shift, I think.
title: Bucket, soap and dish gloves

body: This map bends along the farm road. The carrot seed in the crease is black and split. I avoided the fields.
title: Map and carrot seed

body: The tarp has a clean rectangle where a crate stood. The seed bag beside it is dusted with the same pale powder. Maybe the load spilled before the crate was taken.
title: Tarp and seed bag

body: The spoon is wrapped in newspaper from the day of the order. The paper lists road closures in a numbered column. Someone circled the closures nearest this stop.
title: Spoon wrapped in newspaper

body: A knotted rope divides the bags. The sack on one side has a green dust mark. The ones on the other side are clean.
title: Rope and seed bags

body: A water bottle sits on the map where two roads meet. The map has a checkpoint mark in tape at that spot. A patrol schedule is penciled in the margin.
title: Water bottle and map

body: The shovel's handle has two different colored clays. The tarp wrapped around it has fresh tears. They look shaped by a narrow truck bed.
title: Shovel and tarp

body: A lunch pot is packed with a stack of numbered tags. The fork inside is taped to a list of names. Half the names are crossed out in the same hand.
title: Pot and fork

body: This tire pump is streaked with pale dust. The seed bag has it too. Both were handled together before.
title: Tire pump and seed bag
